column1: eval-011,test,multi_section,"What's the difference between budget-based and impression-based IOs, and how do I create a budget-based one from the Campaigns app?",,"A budget-based IO caps the total monetary spend of its campaigns, while an impression-based IO caps total impressions. To create a budget-based IO, open the Campaigns app, select + Create Insertion Order, and choose Budget under Budget Type. The Budget Type can't be changed after the IO is created.","- Budget-based IOs set a monetary cap on spend; impression-based IOs cap impressions
- In the Campaigns app, select + Create Insertion Order
- Choose Budget in the Budget Type section
- The Budget Type can't be changed after creation","The difference between budget-based and impression-based insertion orders (IOs) lies in their primary goals and how they control campaign serving:

- **Budget-based IOs** regulate overall campaign spending by setting a fixed monetary budget. All assigned campaigns stop serving once their cumulative spend reaches this budget. This type is suitable when you want financial control and to ensure campaigns stop spending after reaching the spend cap.

- **Impression-based IOs** emphasize brand exposure by setting an impression budget. All assigned campaigns stop serving once their cumulative served impressions reach this impression cap. This type is ideal when the goal is to maximize ad visibility and brand awareness.
To create a budget-based IO from the Campaigns app, follow these steps:
1. Open the Campaigns app.
2. Select **+ Create Insertion Order** to open the creation window.
3. Enter a unique name for the IO.
4. Set the start date, hours, and minutes, then click **Apply**.
5. Select the appropriate time zone.
6. Choose **Budget** as the Budget Type.
7. Click **Create** to finish creating the budget-based IO.

After creation, you will be redirected to the Insertion Order Info page where you can define the IO budget, manage the IO, and add campaigns to it.",answered,answered,"https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8481053-budget-based-and-impression-based-insertion-order-io-overview

column1: eval-012,test,multi_section,"What is a Pre-bid audience, and how do I add one to a new campaign from the Campaigns app?",,"A Pre-bid audience is a group of fraud and invalid traffic (IVT), brand suitability, viewability and supply refinement pre-bid segments that you select. To add one: open the Campaigns app, choose an IO, click + Create Campaign, expand the Pre-bid Audience section, and pick an audience from the Select Audiences menu (or add individual segments).","- Pre-bid audiences group IVT, brand suitability, viewability and supply refinement pre-bid segments
- Open the Campaigns app, choose an IO and click + Create Campaign
- Expand the Pre-bid Audience section

- Choose an existing audience from Select Audiences, or add individual segments","A Pre-bid audience is a group of pre-bid segments related to fraud and invalid traffic (IVT), brand suitability, viewability, and supply refinement that you select and group together. It is recommended to create a Pre-bid audience when you plan to use the same set of pre-bid segments across multiple campaigns, allowing you to add the audience to campaigns instead of manually selecting individual segments each time. Currently, Pre-bid audiences can be created with DoubleVerify (DV) pre-bid segments.
To add a Pre-bid audience to a new campaign from the Campaigns app, follow these steps:
1. Open the Campaigns app.
2. Choose an Insertion Order (IO) to arrive at the Insertion Order Info page.
3. Click + Create Campaign to open the new campaign form.
4. Locate and expand the Pre-bid Audience section.
5. To choose an existing audience, open the Select Audiences menu and click the audience’s name.
6. To choose individual segments, click + Add Pre-bid Segments, then search or browse and select the desired segments.
7. Review and manage the segments you added; you can remove any unwanted segments.
8. Optionally, save your campaign’s targeting settings as a new campaign template.
9. Save your changes by clicking Save as Draft or Run to create the campaign.

This process allows you to efficiently target high-quality media and align ad targeting with brand standards by using pre-bid verification segments.",answered,answered,"https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8698628-create-or-manage-a-pre-bid-audience
